components.name: Curve25519 ECDH (Monero one-time-key derivation, stealth addresses)
FCMP++ full-chain membership proofs (Helios/Selene curve trees)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Unit-test coverage for epee's HTTP Digest auth, which retains the historic MD5 algorithm for backwards compatibility (md5_hex helper over EVP_md5 plus RFC-2617 vectors). The live implementation is http_auth.cpp:165-180 (struct md5_ over EVP_md5, registered in digest_algorithms) — filed as a separate finding. MD5 is collision-broken classically; irrelevant to Shor.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Certificate verification is fully skipped (SSL_VERIFY_NONE) when the operator configures verification "none" (--ssl-allow-any-cert / ssl_verification_t::none), or when a server runs without client-CA/fingerprint config (lines 403-404). MITM exposure on those configurations; changeable here (e.g. require fingerprint pinning for non-localhost RPC).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Posture-control sweep, 122 sites. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: rand() in LMDB's bundled memory-stress tests (mtest*.c) — random page values/sizes for B-tree stress runs; vendor test utilities, not a security context. Monero's production randomness comes from libsodium/randombytes (urandom). Kept as the vendored tree's RNG inventory; no key material derives from rand().

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Trezor transport authenticates session messages with a Poly1305 tag: tag check at protocol.cpp:127-132, failures raise Poly1305TagInvalid (exceptions.hpp:57). MAC only, PQ-fine; inventories the Trezor session-key layer that protects device RPC.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The iteration count is defined inside the externally-fetched tevador polyseed library (polyseed_create/polyseed_init are called at polyseed.cpp:158 but the C library source is not vendored in this tree — only the Monero-side KDF provider crypto_pbkdf2_sha256, pbkdf2.c:43, registered at polyseed.cpp:88, is). Polyseed runs PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 over tens of thousands of rounds per spec — below OWASP's 600k password-KDF guidance, but the stretched input is a random 128-bit seed, not a human password,

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 ECDSA declared as a dependency of the fcmp_pp Rust crate (FCMP++ full-chain membership proofs). The secp256k1 layer of the fcmp++ multi-curve tree: Shor breaks the discrete log, collapsing membership/ownership proofs and the curve-tree binding. Dependency inventory; changeable here by migrating the tree to PQ layers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: gen_ssl_cert encrypts the generated PKCS#8 private key with AES-128-CFB (passphrase-derived key) — legacy unauthenticated mode (PEM encryption, PKCS#5-style), PQ-secure cipher but no integrity protection on the private-key file. The RSA key itself is the quantum-relevant asset, filed separately.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: python-rpc functional-test framework's fixed background-mining password ("custom-background-password") — test scaffolding credential used by wallet.py's background-mining tests, not a production secret. Recorded as hardcoded-credential inventory in the test framework.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 27 sites are live ECDH: (1) net_ssl.cpp:215 — the epee TLS cipher list pins ECDHE-only key exchange (ECDHE-ECDSA/ECDHE-RSA with CHACHA20-POLY1305/AES-GCM) for P2P, RPC and ZMQ sockets: passive capture today, Shor decrypts later — the primary harvest-now-decrypt-later surface; (2) ringct amount masking: rctSigs.cpp:1092/1227 hwdev.ecdhEncode derives per-output amount/mask keys via curve25519 DH (8rA), consumed through device_ledger.cpp:1866 and trezor protocol.cpp:666-700 — a quantum attacker

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Monero's homegrown core-crypto build kit: crypto_ops_builder generates src/crypto/crypto-ops.c from ref10-derived ed25519 sources (fe25519/ge25519/sc25519/sha512/ed25519 objects; urandom-fed randombytes.c). Every Monero key, signature, ring signature and Pedersen commitment is ed25519/curve25519 — a quantum attacker recovers all secret keys via Shor, collapsing spend-authority, amounts and anonymity. PQ migration is a protocol redesign (Lattice-based ring signatures are research-stage), not a li

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Carrot address-scheme support: converts Ed25519 points to X25519 coordinates (RFC 7748 §4.1; "ConvertPointE" in the Carrot spec) inside Monero's own crypto layer (crypto-ops.c/h). X25519 DH is Shor-vulnerable: a quantum attacker derives Carrot shared secrets, breaking payment forwarding/unlinkability. No production caller found in-tree yet — staged for the Carrot release; changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The epee TLS cipher list includes ECDHE-ECDSA suites: TLS handshake authentication via ECDSA on NIST curves. Shor breaks ECDSA signing keys, so both the KEX and the cert authentication fall together; migration needs hybrid KEX + ML-DSA certs. See the tls_key_exchange finding at net_ssl.cpp:215.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: curve25519 (curve25519-dalek) dependency of the fcmp_pp Rust crate — ed25519 layer of the FCMP++ curve tree. Shor breaks curve25519 DL, so all fcmp++ proof layers fall. Dependency inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: NIST P-256 ECDSA declared in the fcmp_pp Cargo.lock — P-256 layer of the FCMP++ curve tree; Shor-vulnerable DL, same migration problem as the secp256k1/ed25519 layers. Dependency inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Unit-test parameterization asserting the enforced minimum protocol version (TLS1_2_VERSION) for epee SSL contexts — documents the production floor, which net_ssl.cpp sets by disabling SSLv3/TLS1.0/TLS1.1 (lines 210-212). A control, not a weakness.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Monero's core hash: Keccak-256 (the original Keccak submission, NOT FIPS SHA-3) — keccakf/keccak1600 (hash.c:40-50), HMAC-Keccak (hmac-keccak.c), used for tx IDs, block IDs, key derivation, signature nonces and the CryptoNight slow hash across 13 files. Every Monero secret key and signature hashes through it. PQ-adequate for preimage (Grover → 128-bit); collision (112-bit) is irrelevant to its uses. The label "SHA-3" is approximate — this is pre-standard Keccak; changing it would be a consensus

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored BLAKE2b implementation (RFC 7693) in src/crypto/blake2b.c/h, plus its in-tree users. Monero uses BLAKE2b for the FCMP++/fcmp hashing path and wallet-related keyed hashing. PQ-secure (Grover → 256→128-bit); presence inventories the second hash family shipped in the codebase alongside Keccak.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 in live use across epee and core: X509 self-signed cert signing (net_ssl.cpp:179), cert fingerprints for pinning (net_ssl.cpp:371, net_ssl.h:186), the generic sha256 helper in src/common/util.cpp:689/703, the HMAC-SHA256 PRF inside polyseed's PBKDF2 (pbkdf2.c:56), and sha256_hex helpers in the http digest-auth unit tests. PQ-adequate (Grover → 128-bit).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA256 (libsodium crypto_auth_hmacsha256) as the PRF inside polyseed's PBKDF2 seed KDF — keyed MAC construction, PQ-fine; inventories the KDF primitive that protects polyseed wallets.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Polyseed wallet-seed KDF: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (libsodium crypto_auth_hmacsha256) stretches the 128-bit polyseed secret for seed storage (registered at polyseed.cpp:88). Grover gives only a 2x speedup against PBKDF2 — PQ-adequate; iteration count judged under the low-iterations object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-128: (a) ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256 in the epee TLS cipher list — fine as AEAD, the ECDHE KEX is the PQ weakness; (b) gen_ssl_cert.cpp:191 AES-128-CFB for the PKCS#8 private-key PEM — unauthenticated legacy mode; Grover halves it to ~64-bit margin at rest.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256(-256) declared in the fcmp_pp Cargo.lock — hashing inside the FCMP++ proof system (commitments/transcript hashing). PQ-adequate (Grover → 128-bit); dependency inventory for the shipped proof system.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256: (a) ECDHE-RSA/ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384 suites in the epee TLS cipher list — PQ-secure AEAD, the ECDHE KEX is the quantum-vulnerable part; (b) slow-hash.c AES-256 round-function (aes_256_assist1/2, etc.) inside the CryptoNight PoW hash — hashing, not encryption. No confidentiality use of AES-256 anywhere in-tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD: (a) TLS 1.2 ECDHE-CHACHA20-POLY1305 suites pinned in the epee cipher list — the cipher is PQ-secure, the ECDHE key exchange is the quantum-vulnerable part (see tls finding at net_ssl.cpp:215); (b) Trezor session messages decrypted via libsodium crypto_aead_chacha20poly1305_ietf_decrypt — symmetric AEAD, PQ-fine. Both are live call sites.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenSSL RAND_bytes supplies the HTTP Digest client nonce (cnonce) — CSPRNG, good posture. Records the randomness source for epee digest-auth challenges; not a weakness.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RustCrypto k256 crate (secp256k1 arithmetic) — one of the curve layers of the fcmp++ N-ary curve tree (FCMP++ full-chain membership proofs). Shor-vulnerable DL; migration requires redesigning the curve tree, not just swapping a library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RustCrypto p256 crate — P-256 layer of the fcmp++ curve tree (FCMP++). Shor-vulnerable DL, same fate as the k256/ed25519 layers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RustCrypto sha2 crate — SHA-256/SHA-512 hashing for the fcmp++ proof system; PQ-fine (Grover → 128-bit). Dependency inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: curve25519-dalek — ed25519 point arithmetic layer of the fcmp++ curve tree (FCMP++). Shor-vulnerable DL: a quantum attacker forges membership/ownership proofs once ed25519 discrete logs fall.
